decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (numbered: 7040/1, 7040/2 , 7040/3, 7040/4B , 7040/5A , 7040/6, Design Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Preliminary Method Statement Received: 01/03/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times: 08:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday and 08:00 to 13:00 on Saturday with no work carried out on the site on Sundays and on Bank Holidays. No work shall be carried out other than inside the building with all doors and windows closed other than for access purposes.

Condition : 4 - There shall be no deliveries to or from the site or any servicing at the site outside the following hours: 08:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday and 08:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays with no such activity on Sundays or Bank Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The exterior of the building shall be in red or brown sandfaced facing bricks or bricks of similar texture and colour with the roof constructed of a minimum 100 mm thick insulated roofing panel with a grey powder coated exterior face.

Condition : 6 - No extraction ventilation or air cooling equipment, nor any associated external ductwork shall be installed at the premises unless it has first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The application shall include details of noise emissions at the point of origin and at the nearest affected residential facade, vibration and, where appropriate, dust and fume suppression measures designed to avoid nuisance to neighbouring residents.
description: Demolition and rebuilding of the existing workshop building
